products.name: Sketch AI
products.note: Design tool AI; macOS native; local processing option; EU design data

profile_text.body:
Sketch is a for-profit design software company founded in 2010 and headquartered in The Hague, Netherlands. Its flagship product is a macOS-native design editor that the company describes as built around a focused interface, an infinite canvas, and zero distractions, intended specifically for designers rather than project managers, developers, or clients. The tool covers design, prototyping, collaboration, and developer handoff within a single environment.

Sketch offers an AI-capable tier tracked under the name Sketch AI, categorized as an image and graphic design tool. According to the held facts, it includes a local processing option and handles EU design data, which aligns with the company's stated emphasis on privacy and independence from larger platform ecosystems. The company describes itself as independent and notes it makes its own decisions on matters ranging from privacy to pricing.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
